task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Hold the white and teal sound microphone and deliver it to another side.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。 The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Hold the white and teal sound microphone and deliver it to another side.
